_meta.data_provenance: [2026-09-18] Recorded with the pre-clamp scan-density revision (18-23 points/dim at T=19.53; 321 at T=1). The released run_13_stress.py clamps refined scan density to [64, 4000] points/dim; paper Table V cites these timings with this provenance stated in its caption.

sep_D500_T19.53125.family: A2EP separable, A=10 c=10, o~U(-5,5) (GPU batch implementation: diagonal scan 0.08s/run, Newton on GPU)
sep_D500_T19.53125.note: GPU batch implementation, same protocol as CPU identify (margin=20, n>=64 lower bound); 100D results match CPU identify (equivalence check); total wall time ~11s for 10 runs

orth_D500_T19.53125.reject_reason: Recovered R falls into the near-degenerate region (Prop. 3): eigh-recovered R has mean column distance 1.41 from the true rotation M (eigen-residual 1.3e-15, numerically exact); near-degenerate 500D Hessian eigenvalues make R non-uniquely recoverable; FFT over rotated coordinates finds no consensus dominant frequency across 500/500 dimensions, so identify returns None. Control: with oracle-R (true M), 500/500 dimensions show consensus period T=20.06 (cross-dim deviation 0.000), i.e., the structure is recoverable; single-frequency synthetic control detects the dominant frequency in 500/500 dimensions (FFT criterion healthy); center perturbation +/-1 still rejected (stable).
orth_D500_T19.53125.note: Empirical applicability boundary: 100/200D orthogonal rotation 100% hits; 500D correctly rejected rather than misreported
orth_D500_T19.53125.boundary: 200D succeeds (10/10 hits) -> fails from 250D (250/280/300/400/500 all rejected; FFT coarse-period consistency fails)
orth_D500_T19.53125.correction_note: [data correction 2026-09-13] This record comes from a simplified simulation script (single-point eigh without voting, not equivalent to the real identify pipeline); its "250D rejection" conclusion was falsified: the real identify (GPU re-implementation; 100D equivalence check vs CPU identify: T=19.5304 vs 19.5308, 10/10 hits both) recovers the rotated structure at 250/300/400/500D; the 500D full pipeline hits 5/5 seeds (F=9.98e-9~3.08e-8, cand_direct, Newton-free). The original reject record is kept as a negative data sample and is no longer used as a paper conclusion. New evidence: _r3_boundary.json / _r3_orth500_full.json / _r3_supp.json
